title: GeoPace White model
description: The city's real buildings along one course, as plain blocks: what the app draws with no key, and the surface its shadows are cast from. Written beside the Course Bundle, which names it, because the geometry is far larger than everything else about a course put together. Bump schema_version on any breaking change.

generated_at.description: When the pipeline wrote this file, ISO-8601 with an explicit UTC offset.

corridor_m.description: How far either side of the course a building had to be to be kept. Buildings further away can still shade the road when the sun is low; they are not drawn.

simplified_m.description: How far a point of an outline was allowed to sit from the wall it is on before it was dropped. 0 means the outlines are as the city publishes them.

buildings.description: Parallel columns: index i of every column describes the same block.

base_m.description: The ground the block stands on, in meters above the WGS84 ellipsoid: the bare-earth height under the middle of the outline, plus the geoid model's offset there (the same conversion the course line's ellipsoid_height_m gets).

roof_m.description: The flat top of the block, in meters above the WGS84 ellipsoid. Never below base_m.

ring.description: Each block's outline as lon, lat, lon, lat… in degrees, going round once and not repeating the first point. Courtyards are not cut out: a block is solid.

sources.description: Every dataset these blocks were built from.

attributions.description: Credits the app must show whenever these buildings are on screen.
